title: APFC 2023 vocabulary reconstructions — sourced, not official transcriptions

questions.prompt: A poet evokes beauty so profound that words cannot adequately describe it. Which adjective best captures this quality?
questions.explanation: Ineffable means too great or intense to be expressed in words. Unknown means not known; proscribed means forbidden; intangible means unable to be touched, not necessarily beyond verbal description.

questions.prompt: A commentator ignores wider national concerns and concentrates on narrow local interests. Which word most specifically characterises this outlook?
questions.explanation: Parochial denotes a narrow, locally confined outlook. Unilateral means one-sided; illiberal concerns intolerance or restriction of freedom; limited is too general to capture the specific local narrowness.
